simple.meaning: דֹּמֶן (dômen) is a Hebrew object word meaning “manure.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 9:37. The surrounding context includes land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֹּמֶן (H1828) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: דֹּמֶן (dômen) / H1828 is traced through 2 Kings 9:37, Psalms 83:11, Jeremiah 8:2, Jeremiah 9:21 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H1828. domen דֹּ֫מֶן noun masculine dung (Arabic ) always in this form and always of corpses, lying on ground as offal 2Kin 9:37 ; Jer 8:2 ; 9:21 ; 16:4 ; 25:33 ; Psa 83:11 .

occurrences.englishText: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the face of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.” ’ ”
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb,

They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.
For death has come up into our windows.

“They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”

The slain of Yahweh will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.
